Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 559 AM EDT Thu Oct 22 2026

- Patchy fog possible this morning with better coverage of fog for 
Friday morning.

- Mild and dry through the weekend.

&&

.AVIATION...

Recent sfc observations and model soundings suggest the boundary 
layer moisture may be too shallow to support much if any radiational 
fog at the terminals this morning, with the advective fog largely 
focussed east of Lake St Clair. Much like the past week, high 
pressure and very dry air will sustain light winds and clear skies 
through the day. Light northerly winds resulting from strengthening 
high pressure will drive the low level moisture now residing across 
far northern Lake Huron and points north into Se Mi tonight. This 
will increase the probabilities for fog and/or low stratus overnight 
into Friday morning.

D21/DTW Convection... Thunderstorms are not forecast through the TAF 
period.

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* None.
